title.zh: 卷三十八 本紀第三十八: 順帝一
title.raw: 卷三十八 本紀第三十八: 順帝一 Volume 38 Annals 38: Shundi 1

sentences.zh: 順帝一

translations.literal: Shundi 1
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 1

sentences.zh: 順帝名妥歡帖睦爾，明宗之長子。

translations.literal: Emperor Shundi, taboo name Toghan Temür, was Mingzong's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shundi, whose taboo name was Toghan Temür, was the eldest son of Mingzong.

sentences.zh: 母罕祿魯氏，名邁來迪，郡王阿兒廝蘭之裔孫也。

translations.literal: His mother was of the Qarluq clan, named Mailaiti, a descendant of Prince Jun Arslan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was of the Qarluq clan, named Mailaiti, a descendant of the prince Arslan.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖取西北諸國，阿兒廝蘭率其眾來降，乃封為郡王，俾領其部族。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Taizu took the northwestern states, Arslan led his people to surrender; he was then enfeoffed as prince and charged with governing his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the beginning, when Taizu conquered the northwestern states, Arslan brought his people to submit. He was enfeoffed as prince and entrusted with leadership of his tribe.

sentences.zh: 及明宗北狩，過其地，納罕祿魯氏。

translations.literal: When Mingzong went north on campaign and passed through that territory, he took a woman of the Qarluq clan.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong traveled north on campaign and passed through those lands, he took a woman of the Qarluq clan as consort.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年四月丙寅，生帝於北方。

translations.literal: Seventh year of Yanyou, fourth month, on bingyin day, the Emperor was born in the north.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yanyou, on the bingyin day of the fourth month, the emperor was born in the north.

sentences.zh: 三年八月己酉，文宗崩，燕鐵木兒請文宗後立太子燕帖古思，後不從，而命立明宗次子懿璘只班，是為寧宗。

translations.literal: Third year, eighth month, on jiyou day, Wenzong died; Yan Temür requested that Wenzong's empress install Crown Prince Yantuǧs; the empress did not comply, but ordered that Mingzong's second son Yishilingjieban be installed — this was Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the jiyou day of the eighth month, Wenzong died. Yan Temür asked Wenzong's empress to enthrone the crown prince Yantuǧs, but she refused and instead had Mingzong's second son Yishilingjieban installed as Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，寧宗崩，燕鐵木兒復請立燕帖古思，文宗後曰：「吾子尚幼，妥歡貼睦爾在廣西，今年十三矣，且明宗之長子，禮當立之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renchen day, Ningzong died; Yan Temür again requested that Yantuǧs be installed; Wenzong's empress said: "My son is still young; Toghan Temür is in Guangxi — he is thirteen this year, and moreover is Mingzong's eldest son; by ritual he ought to be installed."
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, Ningzong died. Yan Temür again pressed for Yantuǧs to be enthroned, but Wenzong's empress said, "My son is still young. Toghan Temür is in Guangxi — he is thirteen this year, and as Mingzong's eldest son he is the one who ought to succeed by right."

sentences.zh: 」乃命中書左丞闊裏吉思迎帝於靜江。

translations.literal: " Thereupon she ordered Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Kuolijisi to welcome the Emperor at Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: " She then ordered Kuolijisi, left chancellor of the Central Secretariat, to go to Jingjiang and escort the emperor back.

sentences.zh: 至良鄉，具鹵簿以迓之。

translations.literal: At Liangxiang, the full imperial guard of honor was prepared to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: At Liangxiang a full imperial escort was assembled to receive him.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒既見帝，並馬徐行，具陳迎立之意。

translations.literal: When Yan Temür met the Emperor, they rode side by side at an easy pace, and he fully explained the intent to welcome and install him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan Temür met the emperor, they rode abreast at an easy pace while he laid out in full the plan to welcome and enthrone him.

sentences.zh: 帝幼且畏之，一無所答。

translations.literal: The Emperor was young and moreover afraid of him, and made not a single reply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was still young and afraid of him, and did not answer a word.

sentences.zh: 於是燕鐵木兒疑之，故帝至京，久不得立。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yan Temür became suspicious of him; therefore after the Emperor reached the capital, he long could not be installed.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür took this as grounds for suspicion, and so even after the emperor reached the capital he was not enthroned for a long time.

sentences.zh: 適太史亦言帝不可立，立則天下亂，以故議未決。

translations.literal: Just then the court astronomers also said the Emperor could not be installed — if installed, the realm would fall into disorder; for this reason the deliberation was not settled.
translations.idiomatic: The court astronomers also declared that the emperor must not be enthroned, warning that enthroning him would throw the realm into chaos, and for this reason the matter remained undecided.

sentences.zh: 遷延者數月，國事皆決於燕鐵木兒，奏文宗後而行之。

translations.literal: The delay lasted several months; all state affairs were decided by Yan Temür, who reported to Wenzong's empress and then acted.
translations.idiomatic: Months passed in delay. Yan Temür decided all affairs of state, reporting to Wenzong's empress before acting on them.

sentences.zh: 俄而燕鐵木兒死，後乃與大臣定議立帝，且曰：「萬歲之後，其傳位於燕帖古思，若武宗、仁宗故事。

translations.literal: Before long Yan Temür died; the empress then joined the great ministers in a settled decision to install the Emperor, and moreover said: "After my ten thousand years, the throne shall pass to Yantuǧs, following the precedent of Wuzong and Renzong."
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yan Temür died. The empress then met with the chief ministers and settled on enthroning the emperor, adding, "After my death the throne shall pass to Yantuǧs, as in the precedent of Wuzong and Renzong."

sentences.zh: 」諸王宗戚奉上璽綬勸進。

translations.literal: " The princes and imperial kin presented the seal and cord and urged his advance to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: " The princes and imperial kinsmen presented the imperial seal and cord and urged him to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 四年六月己巳，帝即位於上都，詔曰：

translations.literal: Fourth year, sixth month, on jisi day, the Emperor ascended the throne at Shangdu and issued an edict, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the sixth month of the fourth year, the emperor ascended the throne at Shangdu and proclaimed an edict:

sentences.zh: 洪惟我太祖皇帝，受命於天，肇造區夏；

translations.literal: Grandly considering our Taizu Emperor, who received the Mandate from Heaven and first created the Middle Kingdom;
translations.idiomatic: Grandly considering how our Taizu Emperor received the Mandate from Heaven and first founded the realm;

sentences.zh: 世祖皇帝，奄有四海，治功大備；

translations.literal: the Shizu Emperor, who embraced all within the four seas and whose governing achievements were greatly complete;
translations.idiomatic: how the Shizu Emperor came to hold all within the four seas and brought governance to full completion;

sentences.zh: 列聖相傳，丕承前烈。

translations.literal: the successive sage emperors who transmitted one to another, greatly inheriting the former accomplishments.
translations.idiomatic: and how the successive sage emperors handed down the throne, greatly continuing the achievements of their predecessors.

sentences.zh: 我皇祖武宗皇帝入纂大統，及致和之季，皇考明宗皇帝遠居朔漠，劄牙篤皇帝戡定內難，讓以天下。

translations.literal: Our imperial ancestor Emperor Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation; at the season of Zhihe, our imperial father Emperor Mingzong dwelt far in the northern desert; Emperor Zhayatu quelled the inner turmoil and yielded the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Our imperial ancestor Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation. At the time of Zhihe our imperial father Mingzong dwelt far in the northern steppe, while Emperor Zhayatu put down the internal turmoil and yielded the realm to him.

sentences.zh: 我皇考賓天，劄牙篤皇帝復正宸極。

translations.literal: Our imperial father ascended to Heaven as guest; Emperor Zhayatu again rectified the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: When our imperial father passed away, Emperor Zhayatu again took his seat upon the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 治化方隆，奄棄臣庶。

translations.literal: Governance and transformation were just ascending when he suddenly abandoned his ministers and people.
translations.idiomatic: His rule was just flourishing when he suddenly left his ministers and people.

sentences.zh: 今皇太后召大臣燕鐵木兒、伯顏等曰：「昔者闊徹伯、脫脫木兒、只兒哈郎等謀逆，以明宗太子為名，又先為八不沙始以妒忌，妄構誣言，疏離骨肉。

translations.literal: Now the empress dowager summoned the great ministers Yan Temür, Bayan, and others, saying: "Formerly Kuochebo, Toto Temür, Jirhalang, and others plotted rebellion in the name of Mingzong's crown prince; moreover, on Budashiri's initiative, out of jealousy they falsely fabricated slanderous words and estranged flesh and bone."
translations.idiomatic: Now the empress dowager summoned the chief ministers Yan Temür, Bayan, and others and said, "In former times Kuochebo, Toto Temür, Jirhalang, and others plotted rebellion in the name of Mingzong's crown prince. Budashiri, moved by jealousy, had first fabricated false accusations that estranged close kin."

sentences.zh: 逆臣等既正其罪，太子遂遷於外。

translations.literal: Once the rebellious ministers had been punished for their crimes, the crown prince was then transferred to the outer regions.
translations.idiomatic: After the traitors were punished for their crimes, the crown prince was sent away to the provinces.

sentences.zh: 劄牙篤皇帝後知其妄。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhayatu later knew this was false.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhayatu later learned that this was false.

sentences.zh: 尋至大漸，顧命有曰：『朕之大位，其以朕兄子繼之。

translations.literal: Before long he reached his final illness; his dying charge said: "My great throne — let my brother's son succeed to it."
translations.idiomatic: Before long he fell gravely ill. His final charge was: "Let my brother's son succeed to the great throne."

sentences.zh: 』」時以朕遠征南服，以朕弟懿璘只班登大位，以安百姓，乃遽至大故。

translations.literal: 』" At that time, because We were on distant campaign in the southern domains, Our younger brother Yishilingjieban ascended the great throne to settle the hundred surnames — yet he suddenly met with great death.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time, because I was on campaign far away in the south, my younger brother Yishilingjieban was enthroned to reassure the people — yet he too suddenly died.

sentences.zh: 皇太后體承劄牙篤皇帝遺意，以武宗皇帝之元孫，明宗皇帝之世嫡，以賢以長，在予一人，遣使迎還。

translations.literal: The empress dowager, embodying Emperor Zhayatu's dying intent, considering that as Wuzong Emperor's eldest grandson and Mingzong Emperor's legitimate heir, by worth and by seniority it lay in Us alone, dispatched envoys to welcome and return Us.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager, honoring Emperor Zhayatu's dying wish, held that as Wuzong's eldest grandson and Mingzong's legitimate heir — worthy and senior — I alone was fit to rule, and sent envoys to bring me back.

sentences.zh: 征集宗室諸王來會，合辭推戴。

translations.literal: The imperial clan and all princes were summoned to assemble; with one voice they urged Our installation.
translations.idiomatic: The princes of the imperial clan were summoned to assemble, and with one voice they urged my enthronement.

sentences.zh: 今奉皇太后勉進之篤，宗親大臣懇請之至，以至順四年六月初八日，即皇帝位於上都。

translations.literal: Now, receiving the empress dowager's earnest urging to advance, and the imperial kin and great ministers' utmost earnest request, on the eighth day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Zhishun, We assumed the imperial throne at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Now, yielding to the empress dowager's earnest urging and the urgent pleas of the imperial kin and chief ministers, on the eighth day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Zhishun I assumed the imperial throne at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 惟天、惟祖宗全付予有家，栗栗危懼，若涉淵冰，罔知攸濟。

translations.literal: Heaven and the ancestors have wholly entrusted the realm to Our house; We tremble in fearful dread, as if treading deep water upon ice, and know not how to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and the ancestors have wholly entrusted the realm to my house. I tremble in fearful dread, as if walking on ice above deep water, and do not know how I shall succeed.

sentences.zh: 尚賴宗親臣鄰，交修不逮，以底隆平。

translations.literal: We still rely on the imperial kin, ministers, and neighbors to join in correcting Our shortcomings, thereby reaching great peace.
translations.idiomatic: I must still rely on the imperial kin, my ministers, and our allies to help me remedy my failings, so that great peace may be achieved.

sentences.zh: 其赦天下。

translations.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 時有阿魯輝帖木兒者，明宗親臣也，言於帝曰：「天下事重，宜委宰相決之，庶可責其成功；

translations.literal: At that time there was Aruq Temür, a close minister of Mingzong, who said to the Emperor: "The affairs of the realm are weighty; they ought to be entrusted to the chancellor for decision, so that success may be charged to him;
translations.idiomatic: At that time Aruq Temür, a trusted minister of Mingzong, said to the emperor, "The affairs of the realm are weighty. You ought to leave them to the chancellor to decide, so that blame or credit for success may fall on him;

sentences.zh: 若躬自聽斷，則必負惡名。

translations.literal: if Your Majesty personally hears and decides cases, you will necessarily bear an ill name."
translations.idiomatic: if you hear and decide cases yourself, you will necessarily bear the blame."

sentences.zh: 」帝信之，由是深居宮中，每事無所專焉。

translations.literal: " The Emperor believed him; from this he dwelt deep within the palace and took charge of nothing in any matter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor believed him. From then on he kept to the inner palace and took charge of nothing himself.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命伯顏為太師、中書右丞相、上柱國、監修國史，兼奎章閣大學士，領學士院、太史院、回回、漢人司天監事；

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Bayan was appointed Grand Preceptor, Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, Pillar of the State, Supervisor of the National History, and concurrently Grand Academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion, overseeing the Academy of Scholars, the Astronomical Bureau, and the Muslim and Han Directorates of Astronomy;
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Bayan was appointed grand preceptor, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, pillar of the state, supervisor of the national history, and concurrently grand academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion, with charge over the Academy of Scholars, the Astronomical Bureau, and the Muslim and Han directorates of astronomy;

sentences.zh: 撒敦為太傅、左丞相。

translations.literal: Sadun was appointed Grand Tutor and Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Sadun was appointed grand tutor and left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 是月，大霖雨，京畿水平地丈餘，饑民四十餘萬，詔以鈔四萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: That month, great torrential rain fell; in the capital region water on level ground was more than a zhang deep; more than four hundred thousand famine victims — an edict ordered relief with forty thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: That month torrential rains fell. In the capital region water on level ground stood more than ten feet deep, and more than four hundred thousand people faced famine. An edict ordered relief with forty thousand ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 涇河溢，關中水災。

translations.literal: The Jing River overflowed; Guanzhong suffered flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing River overflowed, and Guanzhong suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 黃河大溢，河南水災。

translations.literal: The Yellow River greatly overflowed; Henan suffered flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks, and Henan suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 兩淮旱，民大饑。

translations.literal: The two Huai regions suffered drought; the people were in great famine.
translations.idiomatic: The two Huai regions suffered drought, and the people faced severe famine.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，霖雨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month — torrential rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn there was torrential rain.

sentences.zh: 潮州路水。

translations.literal: Chaozhou Circuit suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozhou Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，鞏昌徽州山崩。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renshen day, mountains collapsed in Gongchang and Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the eighth month, mountains collapsed in Gongchang and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，立燕鐵木兒女伯牙吾氏為皇后。

translations.literal: That month, Yan Temür's daughter of the Bayawu clan was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yan Temür's daughter of the Bayawu clan was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiawu day, the moon transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the ninth month, the moon transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon transgressed Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，中書省臣言：「官員遞升，窒礙選法。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Central Secretariat officials said: "Officials' successive promotions obstruct the selection regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "Successive promotions of officials obstruct the selection regulations.

sentences.zh: 今請自省、院、臺官外，其餘不許遞升。

translations.literal: We now request that apart from officials of the Secretariat, Academies, and Censorate, the rest not be permitted successive promotion."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that apart from officials of the Secretariat, the academies, and the Censorate, no others be permitted successive promotion."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the moon transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the moon transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔太師、右丞相伯顏，太傅、左丞相撒敦，專理國家大事，其餘官不得兼領三職。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, an edict ordered Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor Bayan and Grand Tutor and Left Chancellor Sadun exclusively to manage the great affairs of state; other officials might not concurrently hold all three offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict directed Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor Bayan and Grand Tutor and Left Chancellor Sadun to manage the great affairs of state exclusively; no other official might concurrently hold all three of those offices.

sentences.zh: 秦州山崩。

translations.literal: Mountains collapsed in Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains collapsed in Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 賑恤寧夏饑民五萬三千人一月。

translations.literal: Famine victims in Ningxia — fifty-three thousand persons — were relieved and succored for one month.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-three thousand famine victims in Ningxia were given relief for one month.

sentences.zh: 詔免儒人役。

translations.literal: An edict exempted Confucian scholars from corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted Confucian scholars from corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，鳳州山崩。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, mountains collapsed in Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, mountains collapsed in Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，改元，詔曰：「在昔世祖皇帝，紹開丕圖，稽古建元，立經陳紀，列聖相承，恪遵成憲。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the era name was changed; the edict said: "In former times Emperor Shizu continued and opened the great design, examined antiquity to establish the era name, set forth the classics and arrayed the regulations; the successive sage emperors inherited one another, reverently following the established statutes.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the era name was changed. The edict said, "In former times Emperor Shizu continued the great design, looked to antiquity to establish the era name, and set forth the classics and regulations. The successive sage emperors inherited one another and reverently followed the established statutes.

sentences.zh: 肆予沖人，嗣大歷服，茲圖治之雲初，嘉與民而更始。

translations.literal: Now We, a young person, have succeeded to the great foundation and robe; this is but the dawn of Our plan for governance — We rejoice with the people in making a new beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Now I, young and untested, have succeeded to the great foundation. This is but the dawn of my plan for governance, and I rejoice with the people in making a new beginning.

sentences.zh: 乃新紀號，誕告多方，其以至順四年為元統元年。

translations.literal: We therefore renew the era designation and broadly announce it to the many regions: let the fourth year of Zhishun be the first year of Yuantong."
translations.idiomatic: I therefore renew the era designation and proclaim it throughout the realm: let the fourth year of Zhishun be the first year of Yuantong."

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 一元運於四時，惟裁成之有道；

translations.literal: The One operates through the four seasons — only through proper regulation and completion is there the Way;
translations.idiomatic: The One operates through the four seasons — only through proper regulation is there the Way;

sentences.zh: 大統綿於萬世，思保佑於無疆。

translations.literal: the great succession extends through ten thousand generations — We think of blessing and protection without bound."
translations.idiomatic: the great succession extends through ten thousand generations — may blessing and protection be without end."

sentences.zh: 」中書省臣言：「凡朝賀遇雨，請便服行禮。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Whenever court congratulations encounter rain, we request that informal dress be worn to perform the rites."
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "Whenever court congratulations fall on a rainy day, we ask that informal dress be permitted for the rites."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，加知樞密院事、答剌罕答裏金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On jisi day, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Darqan Dari were promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Darqan Dari were promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔以察罕腦兒宣慰司人民，止令應當徽政院差發。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict ordered that the people of the Chaghanao'er Pacification Commission should answer only to requisitions from the Bureau of Imperial Household Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, an edict directed that the people of the Chaghanao'er Pacification Commission answer only to requisitions from the Bureau of Imperial Household Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，雲南亻嵬羅土官渾鄧馬弄來貢方物，詔以其地升立散府。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Yunnan's Waluo native official Hundengmanong came to present tribute goods; an edict ordered that his territory be elevated and established as a subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Hundengmanong, native official of Waluo in Yunnan, came to present tribute goods. An edict elevated his territory and established it as a subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，依皇太后行年之數，釋放罪囚二十七人。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, according to the empress dowager's count of years, twenty-seven convicted prisoners were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, in accordance with the empress dowager's age, twenty-seven convicted prisoners were released.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，奉文宗皇帝及太皇太后御容於大承天護聖寺，命左丞相撒敦為隆祥使，奉其祭祀。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, the imperial portraits of Emperor Wenzong and the grand empress dowager were installed at the Great Chengtian Protecting Sage Temple; Left Chancellor Sadun was appointed Longxiang Commissioner to conduct their sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the imperial portraits of Emperor Wenzong and the grand empress dowager were installed at the Great Chengtian Protecting Sage Temple. Left Chancellor Sadun was appointed Longxiang Commissioner to oversee their sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔以高郵府為伯顏食邑。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, an edict made Gaoyou Prefecture Bayan's fief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, an edict made Gaoyou Prefecture Bayan's fief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，封撒敦為榮王，食邑廬州。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Sadun was enfeoffed as Prince of Rong, with Luzhou as his fief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Sadun was enfeoffed as Prince of Rong, with Luzhou as his fief.

sentences.zh: 唐其勢襲父封為太平王，進階金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Tangqishi inherited his father's enfeoffment as Prince of Taiping and was advanced to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Tangqishi inherited his father's title as Prince of Taiping and was promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，中書省臣請集議武宗、英宗、明宗三朝皇后升祔。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Central Secretariat officials requested a collective deliberation on installing the empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, officials of the Central Secretariat requested a collective deliberation on installing the empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯朔，罷富州金課。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day of the month on xinmao, the gold tax in Fuzhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, the xinmao day, the gold tax in Fuzhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鞏昌成紀縣地裂山崩，令有司賑被災人民。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the ground split and mountains collapsed in Gongchang's Chengji County; officials were ordered to relieve the disaster-stricken people.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the ground split and mountains collapsed in Chengji County of Gongchang. Officials were ordered to relieve the disaster-stricken people.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，起棕毛殿。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, construction began on the Palm-Fiber Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, construction began on the Palm-Fiber Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，申飭鹽運司。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the Salt Transport Commission was admonished and instructed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Salt Transport Commission was admonished and instructed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，江西、湖廣、江浙、河南復立榷茶運司。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the Tea Monopoly Transport Commissions in Jiangxi, Huguang, Jiangzhe, and Henan were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the Tea Monopoly Transport Commissions in Jiangxi, Huguang, Jiangzhe, and Henan were re-established.

sentences.zh: 追謚劄牙篤皇帝為聖明元孝皇帝，廟號文宗。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhayatu was posthumously titled Emperor Shengming Yuanxiao, with temple name Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhayatu was posthumously titled Emperor Shengming Yuanxiao, with the temple name Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 時寢廟未建，於英宗室次權結彩殿，以奉安神主。

translations.literal: At that time the spirit temple had not yet been built; at Yingzong's shrine position a temporary colored hall was erected to install the spirit tablets.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the spirit temple had not yet been built. A temporary colored hall was erected at Yingzong's shrine position to install the spirit tablets.

sentences.zh: 封伯顏為秦王，錫金印。

translations.literal: Bayan was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 是日，秦州山崩地裂。

translations.literal: That day, mountains collapsed and the ground split in Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That day mountains collapsed and the ground split open in Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 夜，太陰犯太微東垣上相。

translations.literal: That night, the moon transgressed the Upper Minister star on the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed the Upper Minister star on the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the moon transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the moon transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰犯亢宿。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the moon transgressed the Neck mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the moon transgressed the Neck mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以燕鐵木兒平江所賜田五百頃，復賜其子唐其勢。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the five hundred qing of fields granted to Yan Temür in Pingjiang were again granted to his son Tangqishi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the five hundred qing of fields granted to Yan Temür in Pingjiang were granted again to his son Tangqishi.

sentences.zh: 罷河間大報恩寺諸色人匠總管府。

translations.literal: The Directorate-General of Artisans of All Categories at Hejian's Great Repaying-Kindness Temple was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate-General of Artisans of All Categories at Hejian's Great Repaying-Kindness Temple was abolished.

sentences.zh: 江浙旱饑，發義倉糧、募富人入粟以賑之。

translations.literal: Jiangzhe suffered drought and famine; charity-granary grain was distributed and the wealthy were recruited to contribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhe suffered drought and famine. Charity-granary grain was distributed and wealthy households were urged to contribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 詔秦王、右丞相伯顏，榮王、左丞相撒敦，統百官，總庶政。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince of Qin and Right Chancellor Bayan and Prince of Rong and Left Chancellor Sadun to command the hundred offices and oversee all civil administration.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Prince of Qin and Right Chancellor Bayan and Prince of Rong and Left Chancellor Sadun to command all officials and oversee civil administration.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，命伯顏提調彰德威武衛。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengshen day, Bayan was ordered to supervise the Zhangde Mighty Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the twelfth month, Bayan was ordered to supervise the Zhangde Mighty Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，廣西徭寇湖南，陷道州，千戶郭震戰死，寇焚掠而去。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Guangxi Yao raiders invaded Hunan, took Daozhou, Thousand-Commander Guo Zhen died in battle, and the raiders burned and plundered before departing.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Yao raiders from Guangxi invaded Hunan and captured Daozhou. Thousand-Commander Guo Zhen died in battle, and the raiders burned and plundered before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣省、臺官分理天下囚，罪狀明者處決，冤者辨之，疑者讞之，淹滯者罪其有司。

translations.literal: On renshen day, officials of the Secretariat and Censorate were dispatched to take charge of prisoners throughout the realm in separate jurisdictions; those whose guilt was clear were executed, the wrongfully accused were cleared, doubtful cases were submitted for review, and officials responsible for prolonged delays were punished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, officials of the Secretariat and Censorate were sent out to review prisoners across the realm. Clear cases were executed, wrongful convictions overturned, doubtful cases referred upward, and officials who had let cases languish were punished.

sentences.zh: 以奴列你他代其父塔剌赤為耽羅國軍民安撫使司達魯花赤，錫三珠虎符。

translations.literal: Nuolienita was appointed darughachi of the Tamna Pacification Commission for Military and Civil Affairs in succession to his father Talaqi, and granted a triple-pearl tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Nuolienita succeeded his father Talaqi as darughachi of the Tamna Pacification Commission for Military and Civil Affairs and was granted a triple-pearl tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禿堅帖木兒致仕，錫太尉印，置僚屬。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Toghto Temür retired from office; the Grand Marshal seal was granted him, and a staff of subordinates was assigned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Toghto Temür retired from office. He was granted the Grand Marshal seal and assigned a staff of subordinates.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，為皇太后置徽政院，設官屬三百六十有六員。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the Huizheng Bureau was established for the empress dowager, with three hundred sixty-six positions in its staff.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, a Huizheng Bureau was established for the empress dowager, with a staff of three hundred sixty-six officials.

sentences.zh: 太白犯壘壁陣，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed Leibi Formation, and the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed Leibi Formation, and the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯進賢。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the moon transgressed Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the moon transgressed Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太陰犯東咸。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the moon transgressed East Saltern.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the moon transgressed East Saltern.

sentences.zh: 元統二年春正月庚寅朔，雨血於汴梁，著衣皆赤。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the second year of Yuantong, on the gengyin new moon, blood rained at Bianliang, staining all who wore clothes red.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon, the first month of spring in the second year of Yuantong, blood rained at Bianliang until every garment turned red.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，東平須城縣、濟寧濟州、曹州濟陰縣水災，民饑，詔以鈔六萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Xucheng County of Dongping, Jizhou of Jining, and Jiyin County of Caozhou suffered flood disaster; the people faced famine; an edict ordered relief with sixty thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, floods struck Xucheng County in Dongping, Jizhou in Jining, and Jiyin County in Caozhou. The people faced famine, and an edict ordered relief with sixty thousand ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 以御史大夫脫別臺為中書平章政事，阿裏海牙為河南行省左丞相。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Toqbietai was appointed associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, and Alihaiya was appointed left chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Toqbietai was appointed associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, and Alihaiya was made left chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，四川大盤洞蠻謀谷什用遣男謀者什用來貢方物，即其地立盤順府，命謀谷什用為知府。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Mougushiyong of the Dapan Cave Miao in Sichuan sent his son Mouzheshiyong to present tribute goods; Panjun Prefecture was established on the spot, and Mougushiyong was appointed prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Mougushiyong of the Dapan Cave Miao in Sichuan sent his son Mouzheshiyong to present tribute. Panjun Prefecture was established on the spot, and Mougushiyong was appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 遣吏部尚書帖住、禮部郎中智熙善使交趾，以《授時曆》賜之。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Tiezhu and section director Zhixishan of the Ministry of Rites were dispatched as envoys to Jiaozhi, and the Treatise on Calendrical Methods was granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Tiezhu and Zhixishan, section director in the Ministry of Rites, were sent as envoys to Jiaozhi and granted the Treatise on Calendrical Methods.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，敕僧道與民一體充役。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict directed that Buddhist and Daoist clerics serve corvée labor on the same basis as common people.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an edict directed that Buddhist and Daoist clerics perform corvée labor on the same terms as common people.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以上文宗皇帝謚號，遣官告祭於南郊。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, in accordance with the late Emperor Wenzong's posthumous title, officials were dispatched to conduct sacrificial announcement at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, in accordance with Emperor Wenzong's posthumous title, officials were dispatched to announce the rites at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷廣教總管府，立行宣政院。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the Directorate-General of Broad Instruction was abolished and the Branch Commission for Buddhist Affairs was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the Directorate-General of Broad Instruction was abolished and the Branch Commission for Buddhist Affairs was established.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，雲南土酋姚安路總管高明來獻方物，錫符印遣之。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Gao Ming, route supervisor of Yao'an in Yunnan, came to present tribute goods; a tally and seal were granted and he was sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Gao Ming, route supervisor of Yao'an in Yunnan, came to present tribute. He was granted a tally and seal and sent home.

sentences.zh: 二月己未朔，詔內外興舉學校。

translations.literal: Second month, on the jiwei new moon, an edict directed the establishment of schools throughout the inner and outer domains.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon of the second month, an edict directed that schools be established throughout the inner and outer domains.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，廣西徭寇邊，殺官吏。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Yao bandits in Guangxi raided the frontier and killed officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Yao bandits in Guangxi raided the frontier and killed officials.

sentences.zh: 廣海官已除而未上者罪之。

translations.literal: Guanghai officials who had already received appointments but had not reported for duty were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghai officials who had received appointments but failed to report for duty were punished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，塞北東涼亭雹，民饑，詔上都留守發倉廩賑之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, hail fell at Dongliang Pavilion in the northern frontier; the people faced famine; an edict ordered the Shangdu garrison commander to distribute grain from the storehouses for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, hail fell at Dongliang Pavilion in the northern frontier and the people faced famine. An edict ordered the Shangdu garrison commander to open the granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命有司以時給宿衛冬衣。

translations.literal: On yichou day, officials were ordered to supply winter clothing to the palace guard on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, officials were ordered to issue winter clothing to the palace guard on schedule.

sentences.zh: 以燕不鄰為太保，置僚屬。

translations.literal: Yan Bulin was appointed Grand Guardian and a staff of subordinates was assigned.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Bulin was appointed grand guardian and assigned a staff of subordinates.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，封也真也不幹為昌寧王，錫金印。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Yejin Bugan was enfeoffed as Prince of Changning and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Yejin Bugan was enfeoffed as Prince of Changning and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太陰犯太微上相。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the moon transgressed the Upper Minister of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the moon transgressed the Upper Minister of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封皇姑妥妥輝為英壽大長公主。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the Emperor's paternal aunt Tuotuohui was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yingshou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the emperor's paternal aunt Tuotuohui was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yingshou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，安豐路旱饑，敕有司賑糶麥萬六千七百石。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Anfeng Circuit suffered drought and famine; officials were directed to sell relief grain — ten thousand six hundred seventy shi of wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Anfeng Circuit suffered drought and famine. Officials were directed to sell ten thousand six hundred seventy shi of wheat for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太廟木陛壞，遣官告祭。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the wooden stairs of the Imperial Ancestral Temple collapsed; officials were dispatched to conduct sacrificial announcement.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the wooden stairs of the Imperial Ancestral Temple collapsed. Officials were dispatched to announce the rites.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 是月，灤河、漆河溢，永平諸縣水災，賑鈔五千錠。

translations.literal: That month, the Luan and Qi Rivers overflowed; counties in Yongping suffered flood disaster; relief was granted in five thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Luan and Qi Rivers overflowed. Counties in Yongping suffered flooding, and relief was granted in five thousand ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 瑞州路水，賑米一萬石。

translations.literal: Ruizhou Circuit suffered flooding; relief grain of ten thousand shi was distributed.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizhou Circuit was flooded, and ten thousand shi of relief grain was distributed.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑朔，詔：「科舉取士，國子學積分、膳學錢糧，儒人免役，悉依累朝舊制；

translations.literal: Third month, on the jichou new moon, an edict said: "In civil-service examinations for selecting scholars, the accumulated-credit system of the Imperial University, provisions and stipends for academy students, and corvée exemptions for Confucian scholars shall all follow the established regulations of successive reigns;
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the third month, an edict declared, "In civil-service examinations for selecting scholars, the Imperial University's accumulated-credit system, provisions and stipends for academy students, and corvée exemptions for Confucian scholars shall all follow the regulations of successive reigns;

sentences.zh: 學校官選有德行學問之人以充。

translations.literal: school officials shall be selected from persons of moral conduct and learning to fill the posts."
translations.idiomatic: and school officials shall be chosen from men of moral conduct and learning."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，以陰陽家言，罷造作四年。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, because yin-yang specialists spoke, construction work was suspended for four years.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, on the advice of yin-yang specialists, construction work was suspended for four years.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，廣西徭賊復起，殺同知元帥吉列思，掠庫物，遣右丞禿魯迷失將兵討之。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Yao bandits in Guangxi rose again, killed Associate Marshal Jiliesi, and plundered treasury goods; Right Vice Chancellor Tughlughmish was dispatched to lead troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Yao bandits in Guangxi rose again, killed Associate Marshal Jiliesi, and plundered the treasury. Right Vice Chancellor Tughlughmish was dispatched to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 復立西番巡捕都元帥府。

translations.literal: The Circuit-Pacifying Grand Marshalate of the Western Tibetans was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Circuit-Pacifying Grand Marshalate of the Western Tibetans was re-established.

sentences.zh: 罷廣誼司，復立覆實司。

translations.literal: The Broad Righteousness Office was abolished and the Verification Office was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Broad Righteousness Office was abolished and the Verification Office was re-established.

sentences.zh: 贈吉烈思官，令其子孫襲職。

translations.literal: Jiliesi was posthumously granted an office, and his descendants were ordered to inherit the post.
translations.idiomatic: Jiliesi was posthumously granted an office, and his descendants were ordered to inherit it.

sentences.zh: 庚子，杭州、鎮江、嘉興、常州、松江、江陰水旱疾疫，敕有司發義倉糧，賑饑民五十七萬二千戶。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Hangzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, Changzhou, Songjiang, and Jiangyin suffered flood, drought, and pestilence; officials were directed to distribute charity-granary grain and relieve five hundred seventy-two thousand famine households.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Hangzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, Changzhou, Songjiang, and Jiangyin suffered flood, drought, and pestilence. Officials were directed to open the charity granaries and relieve five hundred seventy-two thousand famine households.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，月食既。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the lunar eclipse reached totality.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the lunar eclipse reached totality.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，中書省臣言：「興和路起建佛事，一路所費，為鈔萬三千五百三十餘錠。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Central Secretariat officials said: "Xinghe Route is undertaking Buddhist rites; what that single route spends comes to more than thirteen thousand five hundred thirty ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "Xinghe Route is undertaking Buddhist rites, and that single route alone spends more than thirteen thousand five hundred thirty ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 請依上都、大都例，給膳僧錢，節其冗費。

translations.literal: We ask that, following the precedent of Shangdu and Dadu, stipends be granted to provisioning monks, and redundant expenses be curtailed."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that, following the precedent of Shangdu and Dadu, stipends be granted to provisioning monks and redundant expenses curtailed."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，中書省臣言：「益都、真定盜起，請選省、院官往督捕之，仍募能擒獲者倍其賞，獲三人者與一官。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Central Secretariat officials said: "Bandits have risen in Yidu and Zhending; we ask that officials of the secretariat and the academies be selected and sent to supervise their capture, and that those who can seize them be given double rewards; whoever seizes three shall receive an official appointment."
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "Bandits have risen in Yidu and Zhending. We ask that officials of the secretariat and the academies be sent to supervise their capture, that rewards be doubled for those who seize them, and that whoever seizes three be granted an official appointment."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以河南行省左丞相阿裏海牙為江浙行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Alihaiya, left chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was appointed left chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Alihaiya, left chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was appointed left chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬子，廣西慶遠府徭賊寇全州，詔平章政事探馬赤統兵二萬人擊之。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Yao bandits of Qingyuan Prefecture in Guangxi raided Quanzhou; an edict ordered Associate Administrator Temürchi to command twenty thousand troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Yao bandits of Qingyuan Prefecture in Guangxi raided Quanzhou. An edict ordered Associate Administrator Temürchi to command twenty thousand troops against them.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔：「蒙古、色目犯奸盜詐偽之罪者，隸宗正府；

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict said: "Mongols and Semuren who commit adultery, theft, or fraud shall be under the Imperial Clan Court;
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict declared, "Mongols and Semuren who commit adultery, theft, or fraud shall fall under the Imperial Clan Court;

sentences.zh: 漢人、南人犯者，屬有司。

translations.literal: Han and Nanren who commit such crimes shall be under the regular authorities."
translations.idiomatic: while Han and Nanren who commit such crimes shall fall under the regular authorities."

sentences.zh: 」是月，山東霖雨，水湧，民饑，賑糶米二萬二千石。

translations.literal: " That month, Shandong suffered torrential rain; waters surged; the people faced famine; relief grain of twenty-two thousand shi was sold.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shandong suffered torrential rain. Waters surged, the people faced famine, and twenty-two thousand shi of relief grain was sold.

sentences.zh: 淮西饑，賑糶米二萬石。

translations.literal: Huai West suffered famine; relief grain of twenty thousand shi was sold.
translations.idiomatic: Huai West suffered famine, and twenty thousand shi of relief grain was sold.

sentences.zh: 湖廣旱，自是月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: Huguang suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the fourth month of summer, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，封宗室蠻子為文濟王。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the imperial clansman Manzi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wenji.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the imperial clansman Manzi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wenji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命順元等處軍民宣撫使、八番等處沿邊宣慰使伯顏溥花承襲父職。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Bayan Buhua, military-civil pacification commissioner of Shunyuan and other places and frontier pacification commissioner of the Eight Fan and other places, was ordered to succeed to his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Bayan Buhua, military-civil pacification commissioner of Shunyuan and other places and frontier pacification commissioner of the Eight Fan and other places, was ordered to succeed to his father's post.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷龍慶州黑峪道上勝火兒站。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the Shangshenghuo'er relay on the Heiyu Road in Longqing Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the Shangshenghuo'er relay on the Heiyu Road in Longqing Prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔：「雲南出征軍士亡歿者，人賜鈔二錠以葬。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict said: "For Yunnan expedition soldiers who died in service, each person shall be granted two ingots of paper money for burial."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, an edict declared, "For Yunnan expedition soldiers who died in service, each person shall receive two ingots of paper money for burial."

sentences.zh: 」壬申，命唐其勢為總管高麗女直漢軍萬戶府達魯花赤，與馬劄兒臺並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: " On renshen day, Tangqishi was appointed darughachi of the Wanhu Office General of Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han Armies, and together with Mazartai was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Tangqishi was appointed darughachi of the Wanhu Office General of Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han Armies, and together with Mazartai was made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太白經天。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 己卯，奉聖明元孝皇帝文宗神主祔於太廟，躬行告祭之禮，樂用宮懸，禮三獻。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenzong, Emperor Shengming Yuanxiao, was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the Emperor personally performed the sacrificial announcement rite, with palace music and the three offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenzong, Emperor Shengming Yuanxiao, was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple. The emperor personally performed the sacrificial announcement rite, with palace music and the three offerings.

sentences.zh: 先是，御史臺臣言：「郊廟，國之大典，王者必行親祀之禮，所以盡尊尊、親親之誠，宜因升祔，有事於太廟。

translations.literal: Previously, Censorate officials had said: "The suburban and ancestral rites are great state ceremonies; the ruler must personally perform the sacrificial rites, thereby fully expressing reverence toward the honored and affection toward kin. It is fitting that, on the occasion of this enshrinement, rites be performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple."
translations.idiomatic: Previously, officials of the Censorate had said, "The suburban and ancestral rites are great state ceremonies. The ruler must perform the sacrifices in person, thereby fully expressing reverence for the honored and affection for kin. On the occasion of this enshrinement, it is fitting that rites be performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple."

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 是日，罷夏季時享。

translations.literal: That day, the summer seasonal offering was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: That day the summer seasonal offering was suspended.

sentences.zh: 詔加榮王、左丞相撒敦開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事，食邑廬州。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Prince of Rong and Left Chancellor Sadun to Commissioner with the Same Trappings as the Three Excellencies of an Opened Princely Household, Pillar of the State of the Upper Grade, Recorder of Military and State Affairs, with Luzhou as his fief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced Prince of Rong and Left Chancellor Sadun to commissioner with the same trappings as the three excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of the state of the upper grade, and recorder of military and state affairs, with Luzhou as his fief.

sentences.zh: 復立杭州四隅錄事司。

translations.literal: The Four Quarters Record Offices of Hangzhou were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Quarters Record Offices of Hangzhou were re-established.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 壬午，復如之。

translations.literal: On renwu day, it was again so.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, it was again so.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉許衡輔世祖以不殺一天下，特錄其孫從宗為章佩監畢珍庫提點。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Xu Heng for assisting Shizu in not executing a single person under Heaven, and specially appointed his grandson Congzong as Director of the Seal Registry Depot in the Bureau of Insignia.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Xu Heng for assisting Shizu in not executing a single person under Heaven, and specially appointed his grandson Congzong as director of the Seal Registry Depot in the Bureau of Insignia.

sentences.zh: 癸未，立鹽局於京師南北城，官自賣鹽，以革專利之弊。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, salt bureaus were established in the northern and southern cities of the capital; the government itself sold salt, to reform the abuse of monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, salt bureaus were established in the northern and southern cities of the capital. The government itself sold salt, reforming the abuse of private monopoly.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，中書省臣言：「佛事布施，費用太廣，以世祖時較之，歲增金三十八錠、銀二百三錠四十兩、繒帛六萬一千六百餘匹、鈔二萬九千二百五十餘錠。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Central Secretariat officials said: "Buddhist rites and charitable distributions — expenses are excessively broad; compared with the time of Shizu, annually they have increased by thirty-eight ingots of gold, two hundred three ingots and forty taels of silver, more than sixty-one thousand six hundred bolts of silks and brocades, and more than twenty-nine thousand two hundred fifty ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "Buddhist rites and charitable distributions have grown far too costly. Compared with the time of Shizu, annual expenses have increased by thirty-eight ingots of gold, two hundred three ingots and forty taels of silver, more than sixty-one thousand six hundred bolts of silks and brocades, and more than twenty-nine thousand two hundred fifty ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 請除累朝期年忌日之外，餘皆罷。

translations.literal: We ask that apart from the anniversary observances of successive reigns, all else be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that apart from the anniversary observances of successive reigns, all else be abolished."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage traveled seasonally to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the imperial carriage traveled seasonally to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 益都、東平路水，設酒禁。

translations.literal: Yidu and Dongping circuits suffered flooding; wine prohibitions were imposed.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu and Dongping circuits suffered flooding, and wine prohibitions were imposed.

sentences.zh: 大名路桑麥災。

translations.literal: Sang and wheat suffered disaster in Daming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Mulberry and wheat crops were ruined in Daming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 成州旱饑，詔出庫鈔及發常平倉米賑之。

translations.literal: Chengzhou suffered drought and famine; an edict ordered notes disbursed from the treasury and grain distributed from the Ever-Normal Granary for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzhou suffered drought and famine. An edict ordered notes disbursed from the treasury and grain distributed from the Ever-Normal Granary for relief.

sentences.zh: 河南旱，自是月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: Henan suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Henan suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，詔威武西寧王阿哈伯之子亦裏黑赤襲其父封。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jichou day, an edict directed Yilihechi, son of Prince of Weiwu and Xining Aqaba, to succeed to his father's enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the fifth month, an edict directed Yilihechi, son of Prince of Weiwu and Xining Aqaba, to succeed to his father's enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 宦者孛羅帖木兒傳皇后旨，取鹽一十萬引入中政院。

translations.literal: The eunuch Boluo Temür conveyed the empress's command and took one hundred thousand salt certificates into the Central Governance Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Boluo Temür conveyed the empress's command and transferred one hundred thousand salt certificates into the Central Governance Bureau.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以唐其勢代撒敦為中書左丞相，撒敦仍商量中書省事。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Tangqishi was appointed to replace Sadun as left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Sadun still deliberated Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Tangqishi replaced Sadun as left chancellor of the Central Secretariat, while Sadun continued to deliberate Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命中書平章政事撒的領蒙古國子監。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Associate Administrator Sadi of the Central Secretariat was ordered to oversee the Mongol Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Associate Administrator Sadi of the Central Secretariat was ordered to oversee the Mongol Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罷洪教提點所。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the Hongjiao Directorship Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the Hongjiao Directorship Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔文濟王蠻子鎮大名，雲南王阿魯鎮雲南，給銀字團牌。

translations.literal: On wushen day, an edict directed Prince of Wenji Manzi to guard Daming and Prince of Yunnan Aru to guard Yunnan, granting silver-character circular tally-plaques.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, an edict directed Prince of Wenji Manzi to guard Daming and Prince of Yunnan Aru to guard Yunnan, granting them silver-character circular tally-plaques.

sentences.zh: 是月，中書省臣言：「江浙大饑，以戶計者五十九萬五百六十四，請發米六萬七百石、鈔二千八百錠，及募富人出粟，發常平、義倉賑之，並存海運糧七十八萬三百七十石以備不虞。

translations.literal: That month, Central Secretariat officials said: "Jiangzhe suffers great famine — by household count, five hundred ninety thousand five hundred sixty-four; we ask that sixty thousand seven hundred shi of grain and two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money be distributed, and the wealthy recruited to contribute grain; Ever-Normal and charity granaries opened for relief; and the seven hundred eighty thousand three hundred seventy shi of sea-transport grain be kept in reserve against emergency."
translations.idiomatic: That month officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "Jiangzhe suffers severe famine — five hundred ninety thousand five hundred sixty-four households by count. We ask that sixty thousand seven hundred shi of grain and two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money be distributed, that wealthy households be urged to contribute grain, that Ever-Normal and charity granaries be opened for relief, and that seven hundred eighty thousand three hundred seventy shi of sea-transport grain be kept in reserve against emergency."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 詔：「王侯宗戚軍站、人匠、鷹坊、控鶴，但隸京師諸縣者，令所在一體役之。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Princes, nobles, imperial kin, military relay households, artisans, hawk offices, and crane handlers who are registered only under metropolitan counties — wherever they are located, let them serve corvée on the same basis as others."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared, "Princes, nobles, imperial kin, military relay households, artisans, hawk offices, and crane handlers registered only under metropolitan counties shall, wherever they are located, perform corvée on the same terms as others."

sentences.zh: 」贈故中書平章政事王泰亨謚清憲。

translations.literal: The late Associate Administrator of the Central Secretariat Wang Taiheng was posthumously granted the posthumous title Qingxian.
translations.idiomatic: The late Associate Administrator of the Central Secretariat Wang Taiheng was posthumously granted the title Qingxian.

sentences.zh: 舊令，三品以上官，立朝有大節及有大功勛於王室者，得賜功臣號及謚。

translations.literal: By former regulation, officials of third rank and above who upheld great integrity at court or rendered great merit to the royal house might be granted a meritorious subject title and a posthumous name.
translations.idiomatic: By former regulation, officials of third rank and above who upheld great integrity at court or rendered great merit to the royal house might be granted a meritorious subject title and a posthumous name.

sentences.zh: 時浸冗濫失實，惟泰亨在中書時，安南請佛書，乞以《九經》賜之，使高麗不受禮遺，為尚書貧不能自給，故特賜是謚。

translations.literal: By then awards had grown excessive and lost real meaning; only Taiheng, while at the Central Secretariat, when Annam requested Buddhist scriptures asked that the Nine Classics be granted instead, had Goryeo refuse gifts and bribes, and served as minister while too poor to support himself — therefore this posthumous title was specially granted.
translations.idiomatic: By then such awards had grown excessive and hollow. Only Taiheng, while at the Central Secretariat, when Annam requested Buddhist scriptures had asked that the Nine Classics be granted instead; he had Goryeo refuse gifts and bribes, and served as minister while too poor to support himself — therefore this posthumous title was specially granted.

sentences.zh: 贈漳州萬戶府知事闞文興英毅侯，妻王氏貞烈夫人，廟號雙節。

translations.literal: Kan Wenxing, overseer of Wanhu Prefecture in Zhangzhou, was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yingyi; his wife Lady Wang as Lady of Steadfast Martyrdom; their shrine titled Double Steadfastness.
translations.idiomatic: Kan Wenxing, overseer of Wanhu Prefecture in Zhangzhou, was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yingyi; his wife Lady Wang as Lady of Steadfast Martyrdom; and their shrine titled Double Steadfastness.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳朔，中書省臣言：「雲南大理、中慶諸路，曩因脫肩、敗狐反叛，民多失業，加以災傷，民饑，請發鈔十萬錠，差官賑恤。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the dingsi new moon, Central Secretariat officials said: "In Dali, Zhongqing, and other routes of Yunnan, because of the earlier rebellions of Tuojian and Baigu many people lost their livelihood; added to this were calamities and harm — the people face famine; we ask that one hundred thousand ingots of paper money be distributed and officials sent to relieve and succor them."
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the sixth month, officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "In Dali, Zhongqing, and other routes of Yunnan, the earlier rebellions of Tuojian and Baigu left many people without livelihood, and calamities added to their distress. The people face famine. We ask that one hundred thousand ingots of paper money be distributed and officials sent to relieve them."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，淮河漲，淮安路山陽縣滿浦、清岡等處民畜房舍多漂溺。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the Huai River rose; at Manpu, Qinggang, and other places in Shanyang County of Huai'an Circuit many people's livestock, houses, and dwellings were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the Huai River rose. At Manpu, Qinggang, and other places in Shanyang County of Huai'an Circuit, many people's livestock and dwellings were swept away and drowned.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宣德府水災，出鈔二千錠賑之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Xuande Prefecture suffered flood disaster; two thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Xuande Prefecture suffered flooding, and two thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，唐其勢辭左丞相不拜，復命撒敦為左丞相。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Tangqishi declined the left chancellorship and refused to accept appointment; Sadun was again appointed left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Tangqishi declined the left chancellorship and refused appointment. Sadun was again appointed left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔蒙古、色目人行父母喪。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, an edict ordered that Mongols and Semuren observe mourning for parents.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, an edict required Mongols and Semuren to observe mourning for their parents.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復立繕工司，造繒帛。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the Silk-Weaving Office was re-established to manufacture silk fabrics.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the Silk-Weaving Office was re-established to manufacture silk fabrics.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，贈燕鐵木兒公忠開濟弘謨同德翊運佐命功臣、開府儀同三司、太師、中書右丞相，追封德王，謚忠武。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Yan Temür was posthumously granted the title of Meritorious Subject of Public Loyalty, Opening Prosperity, Grand Planning, Shared Virtue, Assisting the Fortune, and Supporting the Mandate; Grand Preceptor; Grand Marshal with the same ceremonial rites as the Three Dukes; Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat; was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of De; posthumous name Zhongwu.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Yan Temür was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Public Loyalty, Opening Prosperity, Grand Planning, Shared Virtue, Assisting the Fortune, and Supporting the Mandate; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and right chancellor of the Central Secretariat; was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of De with the posthumous name Zhongwu.

sentences.zh: 是月，彰德雨白毛。

translations.literal: That month, white hair-like substance fell as rain in Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhangde saw rain of white filaments.

sentences.zh: 大寧、廣寧、遼陽、開元、沈陽、懿州水旱蝗，大饑，詔以鈔二萬錠，遣官賑之。

translations.literal: Daning, Guangning, Liaoyang, Kaiyuan, Shenyang, and Yizhou suffered flood, drought, and locusts; there was severe famine; an edict ordered twenty thousand ingots of paper money and dispatched officials to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Daning, Guangning, Liaoyang, Kaiyuan, Shenyang, and Yizhou suffered floods, drought, and locusts, and famine grew severe. An edict ordered twenty thousand ingots of paper money and dispatched officials to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，戒陰陽人毋得於貴戚之家妄言禍福。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dinghai day, a warning was issued that yin-yang practitioners must not at noble and imperial kin households rashly speak of fortune and calamity.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dinghai day, it was decreed that yin-yang practitioners must not at the houses of the nobility and imperial kin rashly prophesy fortune or calamity.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祭太祖、太宗、睿宗三朝御容。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the imperial portraits of the Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong reigns were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, sacrifices were offered to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 罷秋季時享。

translations.literal: The autumn seasonal offering was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn seasonal offering was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，帝幸大安閣。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the Emperor visited the Da'an Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the emperor visited the Da'an Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 是日，宴侍臣於奎章閣。

translations.literal: That day, attending ministers were feasted at the Kui Zhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the emperor feasted his attending ministers at the Kui Zhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Venus crossed the heavens.

translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the moon transgressed Xuanyuan and Venus transgressed Saturn.
