sentences.zh: 丙申，中書省臣言：「甘肅甘州路十字寺奉安世祖皇帝母別吉太后於內，請定祭禮。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Central Secretariat officials said: "At Cross Temple on Ganzhou Route in Gansu, Empress Dowager Kökejin, mother of Emperor Shizu, is enshrined within; we request that sacrificial rites be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, officials of the Central Secretariat reported, "At Cross Temple on Ganzhou Route in Gansu, Empress Dowager Kökejin, mother of Emperor Shizu, is enshrined within. We request that sacrificial rites be fixed.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以沾益州所轄羅山、石梁、交水三縣並歸巡檢司。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the three counties of Luoshan, Shiliang, and Jiaoshui under Zhan'yi Prefecture were merged under an inspection office.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the three counties of Luoshan, Shiliang, and Jiaoshui under Zhan'yi Prefecture were merged under an inspection office.

sentences.zh: 月食。

translations.literal: There was a lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: There was a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己亥，龍興路饑，出糧九萬九千八百石賑其民。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Longxing Circuit faced famine; ninety-nine thousand eight hundred shi of grain was disbursed to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Longxing Circuit faced famine, and ninety-nine thousand eight hundred shi of grain was disbursed to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 庚子，御史臺臣言：「高麗為國首效臣節，而近年屢遣使往選取媵妾，至使生女不舉，女長不嫁，乞賜禁止。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, censorate officials said: "Goryeo was the first among states to offer loyal service, yet in recent years envoys have repeatedly been sent to select concubines and attendants, so that families do not rear newborn girls and do not marry grown daughters; we beg that this be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, censorate officials reported, "Goryeo was the first among states to offer loyal service, yet in recent years envoys have repeatedly been sent to select concubines and attendants, so that families do not rear newborn girls and do not marry grown daughters. We beg that this be forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言，帝生母太后神主宜於太廟安奉，命集議其禮。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials said the spirit tablet of the emperor's birth mother, the empress dowager, ought to be enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an order was issued to assemble deliberation on the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Central Secretariat reported that the spirit tablet of the emperor's birth mother, the empress dowager, ought to be enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and an order was issued to assemble deliberation on the rites.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，山東、河間、兩淮、福建四處增鹽課一十八萬五千引，中書請權罷征，止令催辦正額。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the salt levy was increased by one hundred eighty-five thousand yin in Shandong, Hejian, Liang-Huai, and Fujian; the Central Secretariat requested that the new levy be suspended by authority and only the regular quota be collected.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the salt levy was increased by one hundred eighty-five thousand yin in Shandong, Hejian, Liang-Huai, and Fujian. The Central Secretariat requested that the new levy be suspended by authority and only the regular quota collected.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以中書左丞王結、參知政事許有壬知經筵事。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Left Vice Chancellor Wang Jie and Vice Administrator Xu Youren were appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Left Vice Chancellor Wang Jie and Vice Administrator Xu Youren were appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 封安南世子陳端午為安南國王。

translations.literal: Chen Duanwu, heir of Annam, was enfeoffed as King of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Duanwu, heir of Annam, was enfeoffed as King of Annam.

sentences.zh: 是月，益都路沂水、日照、蒙陰、莒縣旱饑，賑米一萬石。

translations.literal: That month, Yishui, Rizhao, Mengyin, and Ju County in Yidu Circuit suffered drought and famine; ten thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yishui, Rizhao, Mengyin, and Ju County in Yidu Circuit suffered drought and famine, and ten thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑朔，詔：「諸官非節制軍馬者，不得佩金虎符。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on the guichou new moon, an edict said: "Officials who do not command and control military horses must not wear the golden tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the fourth month of summer, an edict declared, "Officials who do not command and control military horses must not wear the golden tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: " On the xinyou day, sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 以江南行御史臺中丞不花為中書省參知政事。

translations.literal: Buqa, vice censor of the Jiangnan Traveling Censorate, was appointed vice administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Buqa, vice censor of the Jiangnan traveling censorate, was appointed vice administrator of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯左執法。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔以鈔五十萬錠，命徽政院散給達達兀魯思、怯薛丹、各愛馬。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, an edict ordered five hundred thousand ingots of notes dispersed by the Huizheng Bureau to the Dada Ulus, the keshig guards, and each ai'maq.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, an edict ordered five hundred thousand ingots of notes to be dispersed by the Huizheng Bureau among the Dada Ulus, the keshig guards, and each ai'maq.

sentences.zh: 己巳，加唐其勢開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Tangqishi was advanced to commissioner with the same trappings as the three excellencies of an opened princely household.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Tangqishi was advanced to commissioner with the same trappings as the three excellencies of an opened princely household.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔翰林國史院纂修累朝實錄及后妃、功臣列傳。

translations.literal: On jimao day, an edict ordered the Hanlin Academy National History Office to compile and revise the veritable records of successive reigns and the collected biographies of empresses and meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict ordered the Hanlin Academy National History Office to compile and revise the veritable records of successive reigns and biographies of empresses and meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷功德、典瑞、營繕、集慶、翊正、群玉、繕工、金玉珠翠諸提舉司。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, the supervisory offices of Meritorious Virtue, Imperial Regalia, Construction and Repair, Jiqing, Yizheng, Qunyu, Silk Repair, and Gold-Jade-Pearl-Jadeite were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the supervisory offices of Meritorious Virtue, Imperial Regalia, Construction and Repair, Jiqing, Yizheng, Qunyu, Silk Repair, and Gold-Jade-Pearl-Jadeite were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 以撒的為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Sadi was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Sadi was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 禁犯御名。

translations.literal: Using the imperial taboo name was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Use of the imperial taboo name was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南旱，賑恤芍陂屯軍糧兩月。

translations.literal: That month, Henan suffered drought; two months of grain were disbursed in relief to the garrison troops at Quepi.
translations.idiomatic: That month Henan suffered drought, and two months of grain were disbursed in relief to the garrison troops at Quepi.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，皇太后以膺受寶、冊，恭謝太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the renwu new moon, the empress dowager, having received the seal and registers, humbly offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month, the empress dowager, having received the seal and registers, humbly offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，占城國遣其臣剌忒納瓦兒撒來獻方物，且言交趾遏其貢道，詔遣使宣諭交趾。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Champa dispatched its minister Latenawarsa to present local products, and moreover reported that Jiaozhi obstructed its tribute route; an edict ordered envoys sent to instruct Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Champa dispatched its minister Latenawarsa to present local products and reported that Jiaozhi was obstructing its tribute route. An edict ordered envoys sent to instruct Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the imperial carriage seasonally toured Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 遣使者詣曲阜孔子廟致祭。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to the Temple of Confucius at Qufu to offer sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to the Temple of Confucius at Qufu to offer sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 加伯撒裏金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Barsar was advanced to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Barsar was promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命嚴謚法，以絕冒濫。

translations.literal: On renchen day, it was ordered that posthumous-title law be strictly enforced to end spurious conferral.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, it was ordered that posthumous-title law be strictly enforced to end spurious conferrals.

sentences.zh: 京畿民饑，詔有司議賑恤。

translations.literal: The people of the capital region faced famine; an edict ordered the responsible offices to deliberate on relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital region faced famine, and an edict ordered the responsible offices to deliberate on relief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，伯顏請以右丞相讓唐其勢，詔不允，命唐其勢為左丞相。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Bayan requested to yield the right chancellorship to Tangqishi; the edict did not grant approval, and Tangqishi was ordered to serve as left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Bayan asked to yield the right chancellorship to Tangqishi, but the edict refused. Tangqishi was instead ordered to serve as left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 是月，永新州饑，賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Yongxin Prefecture faced famine; relief was disbursed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yongxin Prefecture faced famine, and relief was disbursed.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，有司言甘肅撒裏畏兀產金銀，請遣官稅之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinyou day, responsible offices reported that Sarigh Uyghur in Gansu produced gold and silver, and requested that officials be dispatched to tax it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the sixth month, responsible offices reported that Sarigh Uyghur in Gansu produced gold and silver and requested that officials be dispatched to levy taxes on it.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，禁服色不得僭上。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, it was forbidden for dress colors to transgress above one's rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, it was forbidden to wear dress colors above one's rank.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷江淮財賦總管府所管杭州、平江、集慶三處提舉司，以其事歸有司。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the three supervisory offices at Hangzhou, Pingjiang, and Jiqing under the Jiang-Huai Revenue General Commission were abolished, and their affairs were returned to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the three supervisory offices at Hangzhou, Pingjiang, and Jiqing under the Jiang-Huai Revenue General Commission were abolished and their affairs returned to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 詔湖南宣慰使司兼都元帥府，總領所轄諸路鎮守軍馬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Hunan Branch Pacification Commission, concurrently the Directorate-General, to command all garrison troops and horses in the circuits under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Hunan branch pacification commission, concurrently the directorate-general, to command all garrison troops and horses in the circuits under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，伯顏奏唐其勢及其弟塔剌海謀逆，誅之。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Bayan reported that Tangqishi and his younger brother Talaqai plotted rebellion, and they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Bayan reported that Tangqishi and his younger brother Talaqai had plotted rebellion, and both were executed.

sentences.zh: 執皇后伯牙吾氏幽於別所。

translations.literal: The empress of the Bayawu clan was seized and confined in a separate residence.
translations.idiomatic: The empress of the Bayawu clan was seized and confined in a separate residence.

sentences.zh: 大霖雨。

translations.literal: Heavy rains fell.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains fell.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，以馬劄兒臺、阿察赤並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the xinsi new moon, Mazartai and Aqchi were both appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the seventh month of autumn, Mazartai and Aqchi were both appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬午，伯顏殺皇后伯牙吾氏於開平民舍。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Bayan killed the empress of the Bayawu clan at a commoner's dwelling in Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Bayan killed the empress of the Bayawu clan at a commoner's dwelling in Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，加馬劄兒臺銀青榮祿大夫、開府儀同三司，領承徽寺。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Mazartai was advanced to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing and commissioner with the same trappings as the three excellencies of an opened princely household, and was appointed to oversee the Chenghui Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Mazartai was promoted to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing and commissioner with the same trappings as the three excellencies of an opened princely household, and was placed in charge of the Chenghui Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，專命伯顏為中書右丞相，罷左丞相不置。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Bayan alone was appointed right chancellor of the Central Secretariat; the left chancellorship was abolished and not filled.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Bayan alone was appointed right chancellor of the Central Secretariat. The left chancellorship was abolished and left unfilled.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，立脫脫禾孫於察罕腦兒之地。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Totoghosun was established at Chaghan Na'ur.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Totoghosun was installed at Chaghan Na'ur.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，罷燕鐵木兒、唐其勢舉用之人。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the persons promoted by Yan Temür and Tangqishi were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, all officials promoted by Yan Temür and Tangqishi were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，誅答裏及剌剌等於市，詔曰：「曩者文宗皇帝以燕鐵木兒嘗有勞伐，父子兄弟顯列朝廷，而輒造事釁，出朕遠方。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Dari and Lala and others were executed in the marketplace; an edict said: "Formerly, because Yan Temür had once had merit in campaigns, his father, sons, and brothers stood prominently in court — yet they rashly created incidents and sent me far away.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Dari, Lala, and others were executed in the marketplace. An edict declared, "Formerly, because Yan Temür had once earned merit in campaigns, his father, sons, and brothers all stood prominently at court — yet they rashly created disturbances and sent me far away.

sentences.zh: 文皇尋悟其妄，有旨傳次於予。

translations.literal: Wenzong soon perceived their falsehood; an order was issued that succession should pass to me.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong soon saw through their deception, and an order was issued that the succession should pass to me.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒貪利幼弱，復立朕弟懿璘質班，不幸崩殂。

translations.literal: Yan Temür, greedily favoring the young and weak, again installed my younger brother Yishilingjieban, who unfortunately died prematurely.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür, greedily favoring the young and weak, again installed my younger brother Yishilingjieban, who unfortunately died prematurely.

sentences.zh: 今丞相伯顏，追奉遺詔，迎朕於南，既至大都，燕鐵木兒猶懷兩端，遷延數月，天隕厥躬。

translations.literal: Now Chancellor Bayan, following the testamentary edict, welcomed me from the south; after I reached Daidu, Yan Temür still wavered between two courses, delaying for several months, until Heaven brought down his person.
translations.idiomatic: Now Chancellor Bayan, following the testamentary edict, went south to welcome me. After I reached Daidu, Yan Temür still wavered and delayed for months until Heaven brought down his person.

sentences.zh: 伯顏等同辭翊戴，乃正宸極。

translations.literal: Bayan and others jointly declined yet supported the enthronement, and the imperial seat was then set right.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan and the others jointly declined yet supported my enthronement, and the throne was set right at last.

sentences.zh: 後撒敦、答裏、唐其勢相襲用事，交通宗王晃火帖木兒，圖危社稷，阿察赤亦嘗與謀，賴伯顏等以次掩捕，明正其罪。

translations.literal: Later Sadun, Dari, and Tangqishi succeeded one another in wielding power, associated with Prince Huanghuo Temür, and plotted to endanger the altars of state; Aqchi also once joined the plot. Thanks to Bayan and others capturing them in succession, their crimes were clearly adjudicated.
translations.idiomatic: Later Sadun, Dari, and Tangqishi wielded power in succession, colluded with Prince Huanghuo Temür, and plotted to endanger the realm. Aqchi had also joined in their conspiracy. Thanks to Bayan and the others, who captured them one after another, their crimes were formally adjudicated.

sentences.zh: 元凶構難，貽我皇太后震驚，朕用兢惕。

translations.literal: The chief villain stirred up calamity and caused shock to the empress dowager; I therefore act with fearful vigilance.
translations.idiomatic: The chief villains stirred up rebellion and shocked the empress dowager. I hold myself in fearful vigilance because of it.

sentences.zh: 永惟皇太后後其所生之子，一以至公為心，親挈大寶，畀予兄弟，跡其定策兩朝，功德隆盛，近古罕比。

translations.literal: Ever considering that the empress dowager put her own son aside, with utmost impartiality at heart she personally took up the Great Treasure and gave it to us brothers — tracing her decisive policy across two reigns, her merit and virtue are lofty and abundant, rarely matched in recent antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Forever mindful that the empress dowager set aside her own son, with utterly impartial heart she personally took up the throne and gave it to us brothers. Tracing her decisive policies across two reigns, her merit and virtue stand lofty and abundant, rarely matched in recent ages.

sentences.zh: 雖嘗奉上尊號，揆之朕心，猶為未盡，已命大臣特議加禮。

translations.literal: Although a supreme honorific title was once presented, measured against my heart it is still insufficient; the great ministers have been ordered to deliberate specially on additional honors.
translations.idiomatic: Though a supreme honorific title was once presented, my heart still finds it insufficient. I have ordered the chief ministers to deliberate specially on further honors.

sentences.zh: 伯顏為武宗捍禦北邊，翼戴文皇，茲又克清大憝，明飭國憲，爰賜答剌罕之號，至於子孫，世世永賴。

translations.literal: Bayan defended the northern frontier for Wuzong, supported Wenzong, and now moreover cleared away the chief enemies and clearly restored the laws of state — the title of Darqan is therefore granted, for his sons and descendants to rely upon in every generation forever.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan defended the northern frontier for Wuzong and supported Wenzong, and now has cleared away the chief enemies and restored the laws of state. The title of Darqan is therefore granted him, for his sons and descendants to rely on in every generation thereafter.

sentences.zh: 可赦天下。

translations.literal: Let the empire be granted an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Let the empire be granted an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 」是月西和州、徽州雨雹，民饑，發米賑貸之。

translations.literal: " That month, Xihe and Huizhou Prefectures suffered hail; the people faced famine; rice was disbursed in relief and loan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xihe and Huizhou prefectures suffered hail, and the people faced famine. Rice was disbursed in relief and on loan.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥朔，熒惑犯氐宿。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the xinhai new moon, Mars transgressed the mansion of Di.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the eighth month, Mars transgressed the mansion of Di.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔以岐陽王完者帖木兒、知樞密院事帖木兒不花並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On guihai day, an edict appointed Prince of Qiyang Wanzhe Temür and bureau of military affairs commissioner Temür Buqa both as censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, an edict appointed Prince of Qiyang Wanzhe Temür and bureau of military affairs commissioner Temür Buqa both as censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，加完者帖木兒太傅。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Wanzhe Temür was advanced to grand tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Wanzhe Temür was promoted to grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，道州、永興水災，發米五千石及義倉糧賑之。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Daozhou and Yongxing suffered flood disaster; five thousand shi of rice and relief grain from charity granaries were disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Daozhou and Yongxing suffered flooding, and five thousand shi of rice plus grain from charity granaries were disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 己卯，議尊皇太后為太皇太后，許有壬諫以為非禮，不從。

translations.literal: On jimao day, deliberation was held on honoring the empress dowager as grand empress dowager; Xu Youren remonstrated that it was contrary to ritual, but his view was not followed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the court debated honoring the empress dowager as grand empress dowager. Xu Youren remonstrated that this was contrary to ritual, but his counsel was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣西徭反，命湖廣行省右丞完者討之。

translations.literal: That month, the Yao of Guangxi rebelled; Wanzhe, right vice councillor of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yao of Guangxi rebelled, and Wanzhe, right vice councillor of the Huguang branch secretariat, was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 沅州等處民饑，賑米二萬七千七百石。

translations.literal: The people of Yuanzhou and other places faced famine; twenty-seven thousand seven hundred shi of rice was disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Yuanzhou and other places faced famine, and twenty-seven thousand seven hundred shi of rice was disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰朔，車駕駐扼胡嶺。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the gengchen new moon, the imperial carriage halted at Huling Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the ninth month, the imperial carriage halted at Huling Pass.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，赦。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, an amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封知樞密院事闊裏吉思為宜國公，太保、中書平章政事定住為宣德王。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, bureau of military affairs commissioner Kuolijisi was enfeoffed as Duke of Yiguo, and grand preceptor and central secretariat grand councillor Dingzhu was enfeoffed as Prince of Xuande.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, bureau of military affairs commissioner Kuolijisi was enfeoffed as Duke of Yiguo, and grand preceptor and central secretariat grand councillor Dingzhu was enfeoffed as Prince of Xuande.

sentences.zh: 夜，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: By night, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 庚子，加中書平章政事徹裏帖木兒銀青榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, central secretariat grand councillor Cher Temür was advanced to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, central secretariat grand councillor Cher Temür was promoted to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing.

sentences.zh: 命有司造太皇太后玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were ordered to make jade registers and a jade seal for the grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices were ordered to make jade registers and a jade seal for the grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「國朝初用宦官，不過數人，今內府執事不下千餘。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "At the beginning of our dynasty eunuchs were employed in no more than a few; today those serving in the inner palace number no fewer than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials reported, "At the founding of our dynasty no more than a few eunuchs were employed, yet today those serving in the inner palace number no fewer than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 乞依舊制，裁減冗濫，廣仁愛之心，省糜費之患。

translations.literal: We beg that according to the old system superfluous appointments be cut back, the heart of humane care be broadened, and the affliction of wasteful expenditure be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that according to the old system superfluous appointments be cut back, humane care be broadened, and wasteful expenditure reduced.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔以烏撒、烏蒙之地隸四川行省。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, an edict ordered the territories of Wusa and Wumeng placed under the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, an edict ordered the territories of Wusa and Wumeng placed under the Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，耒陽、常寧、道州民饑，以米萬六千石並常平米賑糶之。

translations.literal: That month, the people of Leiyang, Changning, and Daozhou faced famine; sixteen thousand shi of rice and Changping-granary rice were disbursed for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Leiyang, Changning, and Daozhou faced famine, and sixteen thousand shi of rice plus Changping-granary rice were disbursed for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 以京畿鹽換羊二萬口。

translations.literal: Capital-region salt was used to exchange for twenty thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-region salt was exchanged for twenty thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jiayin day, Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the tenth month of winter, Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以大司農塔失海牙為太尉，置僚屬，商議中書省事。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Grand Secretariat of Agriculture Tash Haiya was appointed grand marshal, with subordinate officials established to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Grand Secretariat of Agriculture Tash Haiya was appointed grand marshal, with subordinate officials established to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以塔失帖木兒為太禧院使，議軍國重事；

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Tashtemür was appointed commissioner of the Taixi Bureau to deliberate on weighty military and state affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Tashtemür was appointed commissioner of the Taixi Bureau to deliberate on weighty military and state affairs;

sentences.zh: 流晃火帖木兒、答裏、唐其勢子孫於邊地。

translations.literal: Prince Huanghuo Temür, Dari, and the descendants of Tangqishi were exiled to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huanghuo Temür, Dari, and the descendants of Tangqishi were exiled to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 詔海道都漕運萬戶府船戶與民一體充役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered ship households of the Maritime Route Grand Transport Wanhu Office to perform corvée labor together with commoners as one body.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered ship households of the maritime route grand transport wanhu office to perform corvée labor on the same terms as commoners.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，加御史大夫帖木兒不花銀青榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Censor-in-Chief Temür Buqa was advanced to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, censor-in-chief Temür Buqa was promoted to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，流御史大夫完者帖木兒於廣海安置。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Wanzhe Temür was exiled and settled in Guanghai.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, censor-in-chief Wanzhe Temür was exiled and settled in Guanghai.

sentences.zh: 完者帖木兒乃賊臣也先鐵木兒骨肉之親，監察御史以為言，故斥之。

translations.literal: Wanzhe Temür was a close kin of the traitor Yesun Temür; supervising censors spoke on this account, and therefore he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wanzhe Temür was a close kin of the traitor Yesun Temür. Supervising censors raised this point, and so he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 選省、院、臺、宗正府通練刑獄之官，分行各道，與廉訪司審決天下囚。

translations.literal: Officials of the secretariats, bureaus, censorates, and Princely Kin Bureau skilled in penal cases were selected to proceed in separate circuits and, together with surveillance commissions, review and decide prisoners throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Officials from the secretariats, bureaus, censorates, and Princely Kin Bureau skilled in penal cases were selected to proceed through the circuits and, together with surveillance commissions, review and decide cases for prisoners throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 以宗王亦思幹兒弟撒昔襲其兄封。

translations.literal: Prince Yesigen'er's younger brother Saxi succeeded to his elder brother's enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yesigen'er's younger brother Saxi succeeded to his elder brother's title.

sentences.zh: 監察御史呂思誠等十九人劾奏徹裏帖木兒之罪，不聽，皆辭去，惟陳允文以不署名留。

translations.literal: Supervising censors Lü Sicheng and nineteen others impeached Cher Temür for crimes; their petition was not heard, and all resigned save Chen Yunwen, who remained because he had not signed it.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censors Lü Sicheng and nineteen others impeached Cher Temür for crimes. Their petition went unheard, and all resigned except Chen Yunwen, who remained because he had not signed it.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太皇太后玉冊、玉寶成，遣官告祭於太廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the jade registers and jade seal for the grand empress dowager were completed; officials were dispatched to announce and sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the jade registers and jade seal for the grand empress dowager were completed, and officials were dispatched to announce the honor and offer sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，以伯顏獨任中書右丞相詔天下。

translations.literal: That month, an edict was issued throughout the empire that Bayan alone held the right chancellorship of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict was issued throughout the empire announcing that Bayan alone held the right chancellorship of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，敕以所在儒學貢士莊田租給宿衛衣糧，詔罷科舉。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengchen day, it was ordered that rent from gentry-estate lands attached to Confucian schools in each locality be used to supply clothing and grain to palace guards; an edict abolished the civil-service examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the eleventh month, it was ordered that rent from gentry-estate lands attached to local Confucian schools supply clothing and grain to palace guards. An edict also abolished the civil-service examinations.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白經天。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，伯顏請內外官悉循資銓註，今後毋得保舉，澀滯選法，從之。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Bayan requested that inner and outer officials all be appointed strictly by seniority in regular selection, that henceforth nominations not be permitted, and that bottlenecks in the selection law be cleared; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Bayan requested that inner and outer officials all be appointed strictly by seniority through regular selection, that nominations no longer be permitted, and that bottlenecks in the selection law be cleared. Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命知樞密院事馬劄兒臺領武備寺。

translations.literal: On guisi day, bureau of military affairs commissioner Mazartai was ordered to oversee the Bureau of Military Materiel.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, bureau of military affairs commissioner Mazartai was ordered to oversee the Bureau of Military Materiel.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 己丑，辰星犯房宿。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Mercury transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Mercury transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以燕鐵木兒、唐其勢、答裏所奪高麗田宅，還其王阿剌忒納失裏。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the fields and dwellings in Goryeo seized by Yan Temür, Tangqishi, and Dari were returned to its king Alte Naseri.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the fields and dwellings in Goryeo seized by Yan Temür, Tangqishi, and Dari were returned to the Goryeo king Alte Naseri.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以戶部尚書徐奭、吏部尚書定住參議中書省事。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Minister of Revenue Xu Yi and Minister of Personnel Dingzhu were appointed to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Minister of Revenue Xu Yi and Minister of Personnel Dingzhu were appointed to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，召前知樞密院事福丁、失剌不花、撒兒的哥還京師。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, former bureau of military affairs commissioners Fuding, Sira Buqa, and Sartiq were summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, former bureau of military affairs commissioners Fuding, Sira Buqa, and Sartiq were summoned back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 初，二人以帝未立，謀誅燕鐵木兒，為所誣貶，故正之。

translations.literal: Initially, because the emperor had not yet been enthroned, the two men plotted to execute Yan Temür; they were falsely accused by him and demoted — therefore they were now vindicated.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, because the emperor had not yet been enthroned, the two men had plotted to execute Yan Temür. Yan Temür falsely accused them and had them demoted — and so they were now vindicated.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太陰犯左執法。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，下詔改元，詔曰：

translations.literal: On xinchou day, an edict was issued changing the reign title; the edict said:
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, an edict was issued changing the reign title. The edict said:

sentences.zh: 朕祗紹天明，入纂丕緒，於今三年，夙夜寅畏，罔敢怠荒。

translations.literal: I respectfully continue Heaven's illumination, entered to succeed to the Great Foundation; up to now three years — morning and night I hold fearful reverence, never daring indolence or neglect.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully continue Heaven's mandate and have entered to succeed to the Great Foundation. Three years have now passed, and morning and night I maintain fearful reverence, never daring indolence or neglect.

sentences.zh: 茲者年谷順成，海宇清謐，朕方增修厥德，日以敬天恤民為務，屬太史上言，星文示儆。

translations.literal: Now the year's grain has ripened in due course, the seas and lands are serene, I am just now further cultivating my virtue, taking reverence for Heaven and compassion for the people as my daily task — and the Grand Astrologer has reported that the stars show a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Now the harvest has ripened in season and the realm lies at peace. I am devoting myself to cultivating virtue, making reverence for Heaven and care for the people my daily task, when the grand astrologer reported that the stars show a warning.

sentences.zh: 將朕德菲薄，有所未逮歟？

translations.literal: Could it be that my virtue is meager and there is something I have not yet attained?
translations.idiomatic: Could it be that my virtue is too slight and that I have fallen short in some way?

sentences.zh: 天心仁愛，俾予以治，有所告戒歟？

translations.literal: Heaven's heart is benevolent, enabling me to govern — is there some admonition to impart?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's heart is benevolent in granting me the mandate to govern — is it offering some admonition?

sentences.zh: 弭災有道，善政為先。

translations.literal: There is a Way to quell calamity; good government comes first.
translations.idiomatic: There is a way to quell calamity, and good government must come first.

sentences.zh: 更號紀年，實惟舊典。

translations.literal: Changing the era name to mark the year is truly an ancient statute.
translations.idiomatic: Changing the reign title to mark the year is truly an ancient precedent.

sentences.zh: 惟世祖皇帝在位長久，天人協和，諸福咸至，祖述之志，良切朕懷。

translations.literal: Only Emperor Shizu reigned long; Heaven and humankind were in harmony; all blessings arrived together — the will to follow the ancestral example lies deeply in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu alone reigned long, with Heaven and humankind in harmony and every blessing gathered to his throne. The resolve to follow his example weighs deeply upon my heart.

sentences.zh: 今特改元統三年仍為至元元年。

translations.literal: Now I specially change the third year of Zhigu back to the first year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore change the third year of Zhigu back to the first year of Zhiyuan.

sentences.zh: 遹遵成憲，誕布寬條，庶格禎祥，永綏景祚。

translations.literal: Strictly following the established statutes, broadly promulgating lenient regulations, hoping to attain auspicious blessings and forever pacify the glorious foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Strictly following the established statutes and broadly promulgating lenient measures, I hope to summon auspicious blessings and secure the realm's foundation forever.

sentences.zh: 赦天下。

translations.literal: Amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 立常平倉。

translations.literal: Ever-Normal Granaries were established.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-Normal Granaries were established.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賜知樞密院事徹裏帖木兒三珠虎符。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, bureau of military affairs commissioner Cher Temür was granted a triple-pearl tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, bureau of military affairs commissioner Cher Temür was granted a triple-pearl tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉朔，荊門州獻紫芝。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on the jiyou new moon, Jingmen Prefecture presented purple fungus.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou new moon of the twelfth month, Jingmen Prefecture presented purple fungus.

sentences.zh: 以廩給司屬通政院。

translations.literal: The Grain Supply Bureau was placed under the Bureau of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: The Grain Supply Bureau was placed under the Bureau of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 加知樞密院事闊裏吉思銀青榮祿大夫，兼左翊蒙古侍衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Bureau of military affairs commissioner Kuolijisi was advanced to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing, and concurrently appointed commander-in-chief of the Left Support Mongol Personal Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of military affairs commissioner Kuolijisi was promoted to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing and concurrently appointed commander-in-chief of the Left Support Mongol Personal Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命雲南行省造軍士錢糧新舊之籍。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to compile new and old registers of soldiers' pay and provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to compile new and old registers of soldiers' pay and provisions.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，制省諸王、公主、駙馬飲膳之費。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the dining expenses of princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were regulated and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the dining expenses of princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were regulated and reduced.

sentences.zh: 詔征高麗王阿剌忒納失裏入朝。

translations.literal: An edict summoned Goryeo king Alte Naseri to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned the Goryeo king Alte Naseri to court.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔伯顏領宮相府。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict directed Bayan to oversee the palace chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict directed Bayan to oversee the palace chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 戊午，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the sun's color was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Venus transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Venus transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，撥廬州、饒州牧地一百頃，賜宣讓王帖木兒不花。

translations.literal: On renxu day, one hundred qing of grazing land in Luzhou and Raozhou were allocated and granted to Prince of Xuanrang Temür Buqa.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, one hundred qing of grazing land in Luzhou and Raozhou was allocated and granted to Prince of Xuanrang Temür Buqa.

sentences.zh: 命四川、雲南、江西行省保選蠻夷官以俟銓註。

translations.literal: Sichuan, Yunnan, and Jiangxi branch secretariats were ordered to nominate and select barbarian and native officials to await official appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan, Yunnan, and Jiangxi branch secretariats were ordered to nominate native officials pending formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，奉玉冊、玉寶，上太皇太后尊號曰贊天開聖徽懿宣昭貞文慈佑儲善衍慶福元太皇太后，詔曰：「欽惟太皇太后，承九廟之托，啟兩朝之業，親以大寶，付之眇躬。

translations.literal: On yichou day, jade registers and a jade seal were presented, and the grand empress dowager was given the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager of Praising Heaven, Opening Sagacity, Graceful Virtue, Illustrious Proclamation, Chaste Culture, Benevolent Protection, Stored Goodness, Extending Blessings, and Fortunate Foundation; an edict said: "Reverently considering the grand empress dowager — she has borne the charge of the nine temples, opened the enterprise of two reigns, and with her own hand entrusted the Great Treasure to my insignificant person.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, jade registers and a jade seal were presented, and the grand empress dowager was given the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager of Praising Heaven, Opening Sagacity, Graceful Virtue, Illustrious Proclamation, Chaste Culture, Benevolent Protection, Stored Goodness, Extending Blessings, and Fortunate Foundation. The edict said, "Reverently considering the grand empress dowager: she bore the charge of the nine temples, opened the enterprise of two reigns, and with her own hand entrusted the Great Treasure to my insignificant self.

sentences.zh: 尚依擁佑之慈，恪遵仁讓之訓，爰極尊崇之典，以昭報本之忱。

translations.literal: Still relying upon her embracing and sustaining kindness, reverently following her teaching of benevolence and yielding, I therefore carry the rites of supreme honor to the utmost, to manifest my devotion in repaying my root.
translations.idiomatic: Still relying upon her sustaining kindness and reverently following her teaching of benevolence and yielding, I therefore perform the rites of supreme honor to manifest my devotion in repaying my debt to her.

sentences.zh: 庸上徽稱，宣告中外。

translations.literal: I therefore present the honorific title and proclaim it within and without.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore present the honorific title and proclaim it throughout the realm, within and without.

sentences.zh: 」命宣政使末吉以司徒就第。

translations.literal: " Xuanzheng Commissioner Moji was ordered to retire to his residence with the title of minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuanzheng commissioner Moji was ordered to retire to his residence as minister of works.

sentences.zh: 太白犯軒轅夫人星。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed the Wife Star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed the Wife Star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太白經天，丁卯，復如之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Venus crossed the sky; on dingmao day, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Venus crossed the sky; on the dingmao day it did so again.

sentences.zh: 夜，太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: At night, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白經天，壬申，復如之。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Venus crossed the sky; on renshen day, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Venus crossed the sky; on the renshen day it did so again.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Jupiter was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Jupiter was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白、歲星皆晝見。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Venus and Jupiter were both visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, both Venus and Jupiter were visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙子，安慶、蘄、黃地震。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Anqing, Qi, and Huang suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, earthquakes struck Anqing, Qi, and Huang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，西番賊起，遣兵擊之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Western Barbarian bandits rose; troops were dispatched to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Western Barbarian rebels rose up, and troops were dispatched against them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蒙古國子監成。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the Mongol Imperial University was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the Mongol Imperial University was completed.

sentences.zh: 是日，太白經天，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: That day, Venus crossed the sky and Jupiter was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: That day Venus crossed the sky and Jupiter was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是月，寶慶路饑，賑糶米三千石。

translations.literal: That month, Baoxing Circuit suffered famine; three thousand shi of relief rice was sold.
translations.idiomatic: That month Baoxing Circuit suffered famine, and three thousand shi of relief rice was sold.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙酉，詔：「四川鹽運司於鹽井仍舊造鹽，余井聽民煮造，收其課十之三。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on yiyou day, an edict said: "The Sichuan Salt Transport Commission shall continue producing salt at the established salt wells; remaining wells are permitted to the people for boiling, and one-third of the tax is collected.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the intercalary month, an edict said, "The Sichuan Salt Transport Commission shall continue producing salt at the established salt wells. The remaining wells are permitted to the people for boiling, with one-third of the levy collected.

sentences.zh: 」熒惑犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: " Mars transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: " Mars transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，日赤如赭，凡三日。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the sun's color was like ochre, for three days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the sun was red as ochre, and remained so for three days.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復以宗正府為大宗正府。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the Clan Court was again made the Grand Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the Clan Court was restored as the Grand Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔宗室脫脫木兒襲封荊王，賜金印，命掌忙來諸軍，設立王府官屬。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an edict ordered imperial clansman Toto Temür to succeed to the enfeoffment as Prince of Jing, granted a gold seal, commanded to manage the Manglai armies, and established princely household officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, an edict ordered imperial clansman Toto Temür to succeed as Prince of Jing and granted him a gold seal. He was commanded to command the Manglai armies, and princely household officials were established.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，御史大夫撒的加銀青榮祿大夫，領奎章閣，知經筵事。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Censor-in-Chief Sadi was advanced to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing, placed in charge of the Kui Zhang Pavilion, and appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, censor-in-chief Sadi was promoted to Grand Master of the Silver Azure and Glorious Blessing, placed in charge of the Kui Zhang Pavilion, and appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，御史臺臣復劾奏中書平章政事徹裏帖木兒罪，罷之。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, censorate officials again impeached and memorialized the crimes of central secretariat grand councillor Cher Temür, and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, censorate officials again impeached central secretariat grand councillor Cher Temür for crimes, and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太陰犯心星。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Heart star.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，流徹裏帖木兒於南安。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Cher Temür was exiled to Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Cher Temür was exiled to Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯箕宿。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the mansion of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the mansion of Ji.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔平章政事塔失海牙領都水、度支二監。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, an edict directed grand councillor Tash Haiya to oversee the directorates of waterways and revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, an edict directed grand councillor Tash Haiya to oversee the directorates of waterways and revenue.

sentences.zh: 是年，江西大水，民饑，賑糶米七萬七千石。

translations.literal: That year, Jiangxi suffered great flood; the people faced famine; seventy-seven thousand shi of relief rice was sold.
translations.idiomatic: That year great floods struck Jiangxi, and the people faced famine. Seventy-seven thousand shi of relief rice was sold.

sentences.zh: 賜天下田租之半。

translations.literal: Half the land tax throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Half the land tax throughout the empire was remitted.

sentences.zh: 凡有妻室之僧，令還俗為民，既而復聽為僧。

translations.literal: As for monks who had wives, they were ordered to return to secular life as common people; afterward they were again permitted to become monks.
translations.idiomatic: Monks who had wives were ordered to return to secular life, but were afterward again permitted to take vows.

sentences.zh: 移犍為縣還舊治。

translations.literal: Qianwei County was moved back to its former seat.
translations.idiomatic: Qianwei County was restored to its former seat of government.
